query: Design a luxury Egypt tour itinerary.
answer:
Here's a luxurious 5-day itinerary that will immerse you in Egypt's rich history while indulging in comfort and elegance. 

---

**Day 1 — Arrival in Cairo**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Arrival at Cairo International Airport** — Welcome to Egypt! A private transfer will take you to your luxury hotel in downtown Cairo. 

**Lunch**
• **Restaurant at the Nile Ritz-Carlton** — Enjoy exquisite Egyptian cuisine with stunning Nile views.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Egyptian Museum** — 3 hours. Discover the treasures of Tutankhamun and other ancient artifacts. Private guided tour included for a more personalized experience.

**Evening**
• **Dinner Cruise on the Nile** — Enjoy a luxurious dinner while sailing the Nile, complete with traditional music and dance performances.

---

**Day 2 — Giza & Cultural Immersion**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Great Pyramids of Giza** — 2-3 hours. Explore the iconic pyramids, including a visit to the Solar Barque Museum. A private Egyptologist guide can enhance your understanding.

**Lunch**
• **Felfela Restaurant** — Famous for its authentic Egyptian dishes, located near the pyramids.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Sphinx and Sound & Light Show** — 2 hours. Enjoy a captivating evening show that narrates the history of the pyramids and Sphinx.

**Evening**
• **Dinner at 139 Restaurant** — Enjoy gourmet dining with views of the pyramids.

---

**Day 3 — Luxor Adventure**

**Morning (7:00–10:00)**
• **Flight to Luxor** — A short flight to Luxor where your private guide will meet you.

**Lunch**
• **Lunch at Sofitel Winter Palace Hotel** — Luxurious dining in a historic setting.

**Afternoon (12:00–17:00)**
• **Karnak Temple Complex** — 2-3 hours. Explore this vast temple complex with a private guide, focusing on its stunning architecture and history.

**Evening**
• **Dinner at Al-Sahaby Lane Restaurant** — Enjoy local delicacies with a view of the Nile.

---

**Day 4 — Valley of the Kings & Lake Nasser**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Valley of the Kings** — 3 hours. Explore the tombs of the pharaohs, including Tutankhamun's tomb, with your private guide.

**Lunch**
• **Lunch at a local café** — Experience authentic Egyptian street food.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Lake Nasser Cruise** — Embark on a luxurious multi-day cruise on Lake Nasser. Enjoy breathtaking views and visits to remote Nubian temples.

**Evening**
• **Onboard Dining Experience** — Indulge in gourmet meals prepared by top chefs during your cruise.

---

**Day 5 — Aswan & Departure**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Visit the Philae Temple** — 2 hours. Explore this beautiful island temple dedicated to the goddess Isis. 

**Lunch**
• **Lunch at the Old Cataract Hotel** — Enjoy a meal with views of the Nile and the Aswan Dam.

**Afternoon (13:00–17:00)**
• **Visit the Nubian Museum** — 1-2 hours. Discover the rich history and culture of Nubia through various artifacts.

**Evening**
• **Private Transfer to Aswan Airport** — Depart for your flight back home with unforgettable memories!

---

**Travel Tips:**
- Book all luxury accommodations and experiences in advance for availability.
- Consider a private guide for a more personalized experience throughout your trip.
- Dress comfortably for sightseeing, but bring smart casual attire for dining.
- Always carry bottled water and sunscreen.

---

Feel free to let me know if you'd like to swap out any experiences or add anything specific!
